{%- extends "layout.html" -%} {#- The first screen, and the only page on the site that is not an article. The hero is here rather than in the Markdown because it is structure, not content: a navy panel hard against a picture, which is the poster composition the identity is built on. What it SAYS comes from the page's own front matter (`eyebrow`, `tagline`, `lead`), so changing the words is still an edit to `docs/index.md`. This also keeps the heading levels honest: the h1 is here, the page's own sections are h2, and nothing is wrapped in a container directive — a heading inside one renders as a rubric paragraph rather than a heading, which costs the page its structure. -#} {%- block main %}
